name: elastic-split-reveal
title: Elastic Split Reveal
description: A split-screen curtain reveal dividing a surface along a central diagonal or horizontal axis with rubberband overshoot on trigger.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Toggle Split Parting: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
